note: PoE2 mosaic palette. Small tileable 'pixel' decorations proven in real hideouts; `pitch` = median within-file nearest-neighbour spacing (world units) observed across data/samples/poe2/*.hideout (raw-text regex over duplicate-key JSON) = the footprint to place them at so tiles abut without blobbing. Large/rare decorations (Vaal Potted Plants ~53, Faridun Lights ~51, Faridun Cages ~19, all furniture) were removed because they blob in color mode. `hex` top-down colour (measured|est). Ink mode auto-selects the darkest entry. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: the PoE2 sample corpus contains no genuine pixel-art hideouts, only normal warm desert/jungle (Faridun/Maraketh/Vaal) builds, so NO decoration reaches pitch <= 5. The finest proven pixels here sit at pitch 6-10, so PoE2 mosaics are inherently coarser than PoE1 and the mosaic engine should use a larger `step`. There is no small dark/black, grey, white, blue, red or purple pixel in the corpus, so ink mode falls back to the darkest available (green Forest Fern) and those hues are unavailable.
